component.name: Weave
component.summary: Read, link and search local Markdown knowledge

description.p: Weave is a local-first Markdown workspace with typed links, a structural graph and relevance-ranked full-text search. Open Knowledge Format Markdown files in folders you own are the source of truth.

Several workspaces can be open at once, each with its own Files and Git sections. Weave includes split view, Kanban boards kept in article frontmatter, built-in Git, and export of a whole workspace as one read-only HTML file.
